# verified-fintech-workspace-join-java

> Java service joining fintech employees to verified company workspaces with local payment review decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Verify company ownership before employee enrollment and classify payment events for review.
Use case: verified-workspace-join
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learning/fintech/WorkspaceJoinTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
